policy: Every experiment exposes a base seed in its dataclass and records it in the generated configuration JSON. Repetition, sample-size, and fold offsets are deterministic in the scripts.

monotone_adaptive_pilot.note: Use run_monotone_release.py; initial lognormal data overlap was replaced in full and retained separately for audit.

initialization_ablation.note: Retrospective paired reuse of the complete corrected monotone cohort, not a new independent evaluation. No new random initialization or optimizer steps.
